step1.title: Welcome!
step1.body: Champ Select Assistant shows champion recommendations and game plans during champion select. The LCU connection reads the current draft in real time.
step1.hint: The app only suggests — it never auto-selects or locks champions for you.

step2.title: Personal Data
step2.body: The app reads your match history and mastery data directly from the League Client. No registration or API key required.
step2.hint: Just keep the League Client open to see your personalized data.

step3.title: Draft IQ
step3.body: Recommendations go beyond win rates — they analyze combo chains, team composition balance, engage/peel gaps, and execution difficulty. Tap 'Detail ↓' to see the full game plan.
step3.hint: Combos like Nocturne + Orianna, AP/AD balance, and blind pick safety are evaluated automatically.

step4.title: Ready!
step4.body: Click "Load match history" and enter champion select. Recommendations will appear automatically.
step4.hint: Tip: The app always stays on top so you won't miss champion select.
